Added 2026-11-08. Apache HttpClient 5.5.1 reaches this project only shaded inside docker-java-transport-zerodep 3.7.1, which Testcontainers uses in the tests alone to talk to the local Docker daemon that starts the test database. CVE-2026-71290 affects the asynchronous client over TLS, while this transport uses the classic client over the daemon's local Unix socket with no TLS at all. CVE-2026-64607 needs a server answering with a malformed Content-Encoding, and the only server is the local Docker daemon the tests themselves run. The artifact is test-scoped and never enters the application archive.
Mitigation: the transport runs only during the build and talks only to the local daemon. The entry is removed once docker-java releases a transport with HttpClient 5.6.4 or later, or Testcontainers depends on one; docker-java-transport-zerodep 3.7.1 and Testcontainers 2.0.5 are the latest releases as of the date above.

Added 2026-11-08. Apache HttpComponents Core 5.3.6 and its HTTP/2 module reach this project only shaded inside docker-java-transport-zerodep 3.7.1, which Testcontainers uses in the tests alone to talk to the local Docker daemon that starts the test database. CVE-2026-54399 and CVE-2026-54428 need a remote server that sends oversized headers or oversized HTTP/2 header blocks, and the only server this transport ever reads is the local Docker daemon, over HTTP/1.1 on its local Unix socket, so the HTTP/2 module is never used. The artifact is test-scoped and never enters the application archive.
Mitigation: the transport runs only during the build and talks only to the local daemon. The entry is removed once docker-java releases a transport with a fixed HttpComponents Core, or Testcontainers depends on one; docker-java-transport-zerodep 3.7.1 and Testcontainers 2.0.5 are the latest releases as of the date above.
